definitions.short: Admah , a place near the Dead Sea
definitions.full: H126. Admah אַדְמָה proper name, of a location city in Vale of Siddim Gen 10:19 ; 14:2 , 8 ; Deut 29:22 ; Hosea 11:8 .

occurrences.englishText: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which Yahweh has made it sick,
“How can I give you up, Ephraim?
